hints.title: Backward Wildcard Simulation
hints.text: Think in reverse. The last stamp applied must match the target characters perfectly. Once identified, replace its characters with wildcard placeholders.

hints.title: Greedy Window Matching
hints.text: A wildcard placeholder can match any letter on earlier stamping passes. Greedily unstamp any window of length equal to the stamp that matches with wildcards and at least one non-wildcard.

hints.title: Iterative Unstamping Queue
hints.text: While un-stamped characters count < target length, scan all start indices from 0 to target.length - stamp.length. If stamp matches window (with ? as wildcard) and introduces >= 1 wildcard, mark the characters as ? and record the index. Reverse the recorded sequence at the end.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Forward simulation branches exponentially because multiple stamping locations can overwrite earlier work.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Working backward greedily turns overlapping ambiguities into flexible wildcard matches, running in polynomial time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize backward simulation where the last stamp is completely visible and subsequent ones can be partially obscured.
complexity.notes: If no further window can be unstamped and question marks remain, target is impossible to stamp.
